translations.web: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
translations.bsb: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,
translations.kjv: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given
